summary: Both adapter host bridges can expose the neutral Plugin::save_state/restore_state contract through their standard ABIs — VST3 via a bridge-owned IBStream ComWrapper plus the spec's 4-call component/controller sequence with [u32 LE comp_len][comp][u32 LE ctrl_len][ctrl] framing, CLAP via clack-extensions PluginState save/load — while kNotImplemented maps to HostError::Unsupported and the stateless fixtures keep their defined decline

Slice start: BridgeStream + frame/unframe + save_component_state/restore_component_state in vst3 host.rs; PluginState wiring in clap host.rs + clack-extensions/state feature; controller.rs dishonest stub fix

VST3: BridgeStream (RefCell<BridgeStreamState>{data,pos}) implements IBStreamTrait read/write/seek/tell with honest partial counts, kInvalidArgument on null/negative args, kResultFalse on borrow conflict/negative-or-overflowing seek, forward seeks allowed with zero-filled gap writes bounded by WIRE_MAX_STATE_BYTES; save/restore helpers drive the VST3 call sequence; single-component skips controller verbs

Foreign-blob rule (design adjustment): blobs < FRAME_HEADER_BYTES(8) cannot be this adapter's serialization, so they are delegated to the plugin as raw component state — strict unframe-first would return PluginFailed for the L1 e2e's RestoreState{[0xAA,0xBB]} and break the lease-external Unsupported oracle; >=8-byte corrupt frames still map to PluginFailed

CLAP: host feature gains clack-extensions/state; ClapPlugin::save_state/restore_state gate on instance presence (PluginFailed pre-init), PluginState extension absence (Unsupported), StateError->PluginFailed; plugin bytes pass through unframed; controller.rs GainController setState/getState corrected from dishonest kResultOk no-ops to kNotImplemented with pinning test

cargo test -p ruviform-plugin-vst3 --features host --lib: 84 passed incl. 9 new state/stream tests (distributed+single round-trip order/payload pins, corrupt-frame rejection, foreign-blob delegation, kNotImplemented->Unsupported, fixture gate+decline); cargo test -p ruviform-plugin-clap --features host --lib: 67 passed incl. rewritten state_verbs_gate_and_fixture_declines

mise run test-l1-real-plugin exit 0: adapter e2e real_adapter_l1_full_series 3+3 pass — SaveState/RestoreState still answer Err(Unsupported) over the wire for both stateless fixtures (VST3 kNotImplemented->Unsupported, CLAP extension-absent->Unsupported); check/lint-l1-real-plugin, fmt-check, per-crate check/lint/test all exit 0

Production state bridge verified at adapter-unit + L1-real-plugin-decline level on Windows OS-L1; real stateful round-trip remains NotRun until the test_stateful fixture slice — in-process COM doubles are not the real-ABI oracle
